notes:
### App — POS + LAN Licensing + mDNS — 2026-06-08

- **fix: `_esc` not defined in pos.js** — item grid threw `ReferenceError: _esc is not defined` on first render; added local HTML-escape helper. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: mDNS LAN auto-discovery** — machine 2 runs `web_server.py` with no arguments and auto-discovers the LAN server (registered as `_dogbox._tcp.local.`) within 3 seconds; opens browser and exits without starting a second Flask instance. `_lan_ip()` uses UDP connect for reliable outbound IP. Requires `pip install zeroconf`. (`web_server.py`)
- **fix: `--lan` opened browser to `0.0.0.0`** — `ERR_ADDRESS_INVALID`; server machine browser now uses `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` while LAN URL display and mDNS advertisement use the real network IP. (`web_server.py`)
- **feat: LAN server mode gated by licence** — `--lan` requires `has_feature("lan")` on the licence; exits with a clear message if not enabled. Licenser issue and edit forms have a "LAN Server — multi-user / multi-machine access" checkbox under Features. (`web_server.py`, `licenser/templates/issue.html`, `licenser/templates/edit.html`)
- **feat: POS included in Pro tier** — POS is available to all Pro users (`TIER_CAPS["full"]`), not a separate feature flag; nav item is hidden for Free users and visible for Pro users (`user.is_pro`). (`web/shared.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`, `web/templates/dashboard.html`)

### App — Point of Sale Module — 2026-06-08

- **feat: POS module** — new point-of-sale module for retail/service front-of-house use. Two-panel touch-optimised UI: item grid (large tap targets, search/filter) on the left, cart with line totals + GST breakdown on the right. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: Cash tender flow** — modal with quick-amount buttons ($20/$50/$100) and live change calculation. Confirmed sale posts invoice + payment atomically in one server call. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Card tender flow** — initiates terminal charge, shows spinner with "Waiting for terminal…" animation, polls every 2s up to 3-minute timeout, then posts the sale on COMPLETED or shows error on DECLINED/TIMEOUT. Cart is preserved on failure so the operator can retry. (`web/static/js/pos.js`)
- **feat: Receipt modal** — shows sale summary with change (cash) or terminal reference (card); `window.print()` button with `@media print` CSS for standard receipt printing. (`web/static/js/pos.js`, `web/static/dbox.css`)
- **feat: POS backend** — `core/pos.py`: `_ensure_pos_defaults()` auto-creates Walk-In Customer system contact, Cash Drawer account (1-1120), and EFTPOS Clearing account (1-1130) on first use; `create_pos_sale()` calls existing `save_invoice()` + `record_payment()` in one transaction; `get_pos_items()` wraps existing item catalogue with search; `get_pos_sales()` returns recent POS sales. (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: POS settings** — `core/pos_settings.py`: single-row `pos_settings` table (provider, api_key, device_id, location_id, cash/card account overrides, walk-in contact override). API key stored base64-encoded; GET endpoint returns `api_key_configured` boolean (never exposes raw key). (`core/pos_settings.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`)
- **feat: Payment terminal adapters** — pluggable dispatcher pattern in `charge_terminal()` / `get_terminal_status()`. Three adapters: (1) **Mock** — auto-completes after 3s, no hardware needed, for dev/demo; (2) **Tyro** — Tyro Integrated EFTPOS API (AU primary); (3) **Square** — Square Terminal API (secondary, AU available). Provider selected in POS settings. (`core/pos.py`)
- **feat: POS nav + tier gate** — nav item "🛒 Point of Sale" added under Transactions; `pos` added to `TIER_CAPS["full"]`; all routes gated with `@tier_required("pos")`. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`, `web/shared.py`, `web/routes/pos.py`)

### App — LAN Concurrency Preparation — 2026-06-08

- **feat: Thread-safe global state** — `threading.Lock()` on `_app_state` in `web/shared.py`; `_do_lock()`, `clear_lock()`, and `api_heartbeat()` in `web/routes/company.py` all acquire the lock before reading/writing. Prevents race conditions under concurrent Flask requests. (`web/shared.py`, `web/routes/company.py`)
- **feat: Thread-safe login rate limiting** — `_login_attempts_lock` in `web/routes/auth.py`; all three rate-limit helpers (`_check_rate_limit`, `_record_attempt`, `_clear_attempts`) wrapped with the lock. (`web/routes/auth.py`)
- **feat: `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` on document number generation** — `save_invoice()` and `create_credit_note()` in `core/ledger.py`, and `save_purchase_order()` in `core/purchase_orders.py` now open with `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` to hold the write lock across number generation + INSERT, preventing duplicate invoice/PO numbers under concurrent writes. (`core/ledger.py`, `core/purchase_orders.py`)
- **feat: `--lan` flag on web_server.py** — `--lan` binds Flask to `0.0.0.0` instead of `127.0.0.1`, prints the machine's LAN IP, and adjusts the already-running check to use `127.0.0.1` regardless. Makes the server accessible to other machines on the same network. (`web_server.py`)
- **feat: `threaded=True`** — Flask runs in multi-threaded mode in both `web/server.py` and `web_server.py` so concurrent clients (back-office + POS terminal) don't block each other. (`web/server.py`, `web_server.py`)

### App — Help Viewer + Settings Sidebar — 2026-06-08

- **fix: In-app help viewer** — three separate breakages resolved: (1) `navigate('help')` had no handler in the switch chain; (2) `help.js` was not included as a `<script>` tag in `dashboard.html`; (3) `web/routes/help.py` blueprint was never imported or registered in `server.py`, so every `/api/help` call returned 404. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`, `web/server.py`)
- **feat: Help viewer CSS** — complete set of `help-*` styles added: two-pane layout (`help-wrap`, `help-sidebar`, `help-pane`), sidebar nav items with active/hover states, search input, guide header, section headings, paragraph/bullet/code-block formatting, and search highlight mark. (`web/static/dbox.css`)
- **fix: Settings sidebar vertical scrollbar** — `.set-layout` changed from `min-height` to `height` (constrains layout to viewport); `overflow-y: auto` added to `.set-nav` so the sidebar scrolls when its content is taller than the window. (`web/static/dbox.css`)
- **docs: Guide content updates** — dashboard KPI section corrected to 3-card row (Bank / Projected / ATO-BAS obligations) matching actual UI; Reports guide extended with EOY Accountant Package and COA Mapping sections; Recurring guide rewritten to cover Invoice, Bill, and Journal template types with multi-line item detail; Contacts guide gains Work Tasks section (recurring tasks, schedule-next modal, invoice-from-tasks). (`tools/build_guides.py`)
- **chore: `help_content.json` regenerated** — 25 guides rebuilt from updated `build_guides.py` content. (`web/static/help_content.json`)

### App — Recurring Transactions — Multi-Line Support — 2026-06-08

- **feat: Multi-line recurring templates** — Invoice and Bill templates now use a line-item table (Description / Qty / Unit Price / Tax / Account) instead of single Amount + Account fields. Journal templates use a double-entry lines table (Account / Debit / Credit / Memo) with running debit/credit totals and an out-of-balance warning. All three types validated before save: Journal requires ≥2 balanced lines with accounts selected; Invoice/Bill requires at least one line with a price. (`web/static/js/recurring.js`)
- **feat: Backward-compatible single-line migration** — existing templates without `lines_json` are auto-converted to a single-line when editing (amount → unit_price for Invoice/Bill; amount → debit for Journal). Saves immediately migrate to `lines_json` format. Engine was already multi-line capable; only the UI needed updating. (`web/static/js/recurring.js`)
- **feat: Lines displayed in template detail panel** — detail view shows a full read-only line items table when `lines_json` is present, with account names resolved server-side. Amount summary label adapts: "Total Dr/Cr" for Journal, "Total (excl. GST)" for Invoice/Bill. (`web/static/js/recurring.js`)
- **feat: Type-change line reset** — switching between Journal and Invoice/Bill families in the edit form resets the lines array to one default line; switching between Invoice and Bill preserves existing lines. (`web/static/js/recurring.js`)
- **backend: `save_template` auto-serializes `lines_json`** — if client sends a Python list, it is JSON-serialised before writing to SQLite so `json.loads()` in the engine always succeeds. (`core/recurring.py`)
- **backend: `GET /api/recurring/<id>` enriched** — parses `lines_json` from JSON string to array before returning; joins `accounts` table to add `account_name` to each line. (`web/routes/jobs.py`)
- **css: `rec-lines-tbl` and related classes** — compact line-item table for use inside the det-panel slide-over; `rec-line-del` delete button; `rec-balance-warn` out-of-balance indicator; `rec-lines-detail` detail-view section. (`web/static/dbox.css`)

### App — Update Banner — 2026-06-07

- **feat: Release notes rendered as formatted text** — added `_renderMarkdown()` helper that escapes HTML then converts `### headings`, `- bullets`, `**bold**`, and `` `code` `` spans to HTML. Previously showed raw markdown syntax. XSS-safe: HTML escaping runs before inline transforms. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`)
- **fix: Release notes modal close button invisible** — header button used `class="modal-x"` which has no CSS; changed to `modal-close` (the standard header close class used across all other modals). (`web/templates/dashboard.html`)
- **fix: Release notes modal body not scrolling** — `modal-box` was not a flex column so `flex:1` on `modal-body` had no effect; `max-height:60vh` on the body fought the box's own `padding:26px` with no outer height constraint. Added `display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-height:90vh` to the box, removed the inline `max-height` from the body, added `min-height:0` for reliable flex scroll. (`web/templates/dashboard.html`)

### Build — 2026-06-07

- **fix: build_dist.py subprocess encoding on Windows** — `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` used the system default cp1252 encoding, mangling UTF-8 characters (em dashes, checkmarks) in git commit messages and stderr output. Added `encoding='utf-8'` to all three `subprocess.run` calls in `build_dist.py` (tag creation, `git()` helper, tag push). (`tools/build_dist.py`)
